steps.content: After checking all the traces and leaving the "crime" scene, Christina feels tired, but her mind is no longer in a muddle.
All the inconsistent details, contradictory discrepancies, and absurd yet unignorable possibilities, all eventually point to one person.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Shalom... if all this is your doing, then...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: What exactly do you want to do...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You seem a bit confused. Do you want to initiate a Scan?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The scan is complete, and Paradeisos has also made an overall assessment of your plan. Although the measures you plan to take are strange, they are indeed reasonable and meet the task requirements.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Whether Coquelic steps into your trap or not, her life is already at its end.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The Garden no longer poses any threat, and you've found the best way to evade the Underground's surveillance and retrieve SHP-13.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your plan is reliable.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Really? You seem a bit different from usual. I thought I might have made a mistake and was about to be inspected.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...At first, our risk assessment of you was very high. We thought you would trigger an alarm quickly and then be immediately destroyed. But that didn't happen.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We've always been by your side, and it's very clear: the plans you've given within the limited time have always been reliable.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Paradeisos trusts you, the Underground is wary of you, and those Dissenters are under your control. You are the most perfect and most suited Hush.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Nine years is too short a time. We regret having to decommission and destroy you like this. It's going to be hard to find a suitable candidate like you in the future.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: If only we still have the cloning technology. Paradeisos could have cloned countless versions of you and maintained the efficient operation of Hush.
Shalom laughs.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Bodies can be cloned, but minds and experiences can't. You're affected by emotions too, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: And besides, the work isn't finished yet, don't be in a hurry to say goodbye to me.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: There's one last step...

She fiddles with the secret letters in her hand. It's a collection of secret letters sent to her daily by Underground spies. Keep the Hush alive, and she'll come back and deal with the Garden—this is the strategy thought out by the Underground. They baited HUSH-X with the Garden, and let her force the Mentor into a dead end.

Hush naturally seized this opportunity. To look for the Shepherd that Paradeisos needs, the Mentor would be a significant threat. Now, at last, everything is settled. The primary plan and the backup plan are all in place. The final task within X's term is finally arranged properly.
It's tough for someone caught in the middle to find peace, Coquelic... I know you've tried your best.
<color=#fb9259>As year's end nears, vast and wide, over dried-up wells, I alone stride.</color>
Come, reap your real target, not the decaying Charity Foundation, not the FAC Commander-in-Chief...
Come find <color=#fb9259>me</color>, Mentor. You won't disappoint me...
